links.outcome: Comprehensive answer rate with vs without guideline-based prompts for CIED infection questions
links.effect: ChatGPT 4o comprehensive answers rose from 80.00% (24/30) to 93.33% (28/30); DeepSeek from 80.00% (24/30) to 90.00% (27/30) with guideline prompts.
links.quote: With guideline prompts, ChatGPT 4o's comprehensive answer rate increased to 93.33% (28/30), while DeepSeek's rate rose to 90.00% (27/30).

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade) of LLM responses about CIED infections
links.effect: ChatGPT 4o Flesch-Kincaid Grade 15.40 ± 1.18 vs DeepSeek 13.91 ± 1.42 (P <.01), indicating complex responses.
links.quote: The Flesch-Kincaid Grade Score for ChatGPT 4o (15.40 ± 1.18) was higher than that of DeepSeek's (13.91 ± 1.42), indicating more complex responses (P <.01).

screen.reason: The study tests the effect of adding guideline-based prompts versus no additional context on the accuracy, completeness, and readability of LLM outputs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek) answering clinical CIED infection questions.
